SELECT m.id, m.scene_code, m.title, m.content_type, m.biz_type, m.link_url, m.sender_user_id, m.delivery_mode, r.is_read, r.read_time, m.create_time, m.update_time, m.create_user, m.update_user FROM in_app_message_recipient r INNER JOIN in_app_message m ON m.id = r.message_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND m.status IN ('SUCCESS', 'PARTIAL')
AND r.is_read = #{query.isRead}
AND m.biz_type LIKE CONCAT(#{query.bizType}, '%')
AND m.title LIKE CONCAT(#{query.title}, '%')
ORDER BY r.is_read ASC, m.create_time DESC

SELECT m.id, m.scene_code, m.title, m.content_type, m.biz_type, m.link_url, m.sender_user_id, m.delivery_mode, COALESCE(s.is_read, 0) AS is_read, s.read_time, m.create_time, m.update_time, m.create_user, m.update_user FROM in_app_message m LEFT JOIN in_app_message_user_status s ON s.message_id = m.id AND s.user_id = #{userId} WHERE m.delivery_mode = 'PULL' AND m.status = 'SUCCESS' AND ( s.id IS NULL OR s.is_deleted = 0 )
AND s.is_read = 1
AND ( s.id IS NULL OR s.is_read = 0 )
AND m.biz_type LIKE CONCAT(#{query.bizType}, '%')
AND m.title LIKE CONCAT(#{query.title}, '%')
ORDER BY COALESCE(s.is_read, 0), m.create_time DESC

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM in_app_message_recipient r INNER JOIN in_app_message m ON m.id = r.message_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.is_read = 0 AND m.status IN ('SUCCESS', 'PARTIAL')

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM in_app_message m LEFT JOIN in_app_message_user_status s ON s.message_id = m.id AND s.user_id = #{userId} WHERE m.delivery_mode = 'PULL' AND m.status = 'SUCCESS' AND ( s.id IS NULL OR s.is_deleted = 0 ) AND ( s.id IS NULL OR s.is_read = 0 )
